remarks: Exquisite waterfront living on Steamboat Road! Be astounded by the breathtaking views of Long Island Sound from every room. Free-standing townhouse sited in a neighborhood w/stunning homes. A short walk to downtown Greenwich, this elegantly renovated unit boasts 3 bedrooms & 3.1 baths. Exceptional architectural elements & meticulous attention to detail, this graciously scaled interior is a constant delight. Features: hardwood floors, high ceilings, private ELEVATOR, fireplaces, built-ins & tall windows make the most of the water views. The gourmet kitchen opens to a dining area. Lovely primary with elegant marble bath. Finished loft (not included in SF) brings the total square footage to 2819. Bonuses: 4 expansive decks (2 covered), 2 garages & 3 additional parking spaces. Truly special.
